name: Europa
tagline: An ice-crusted ocean world — arguably the best place beyond Earth to look for life.
history: Beneath Europa's fractured ice shell — a surface webbed with rusty lineae and chaos terrain — lies a global saltwater ocean with perhaps twice the volume of Earth's. Tidal heating keeps it liquid, and water vapor plumes spotted near the south pole hint the ocean vents into space. Galileo (the mission, 1995–2003) confirmed the subsurface sea through magnetic induction; NASA's Europa Clipper, launched October 2024, arrives in 2030 to map the ice, taste the plumes, and assess whether the ocean could harbor life.
